title: Respect natural sorting preferences from Dolphin
line: Folder View now sorts numbered files naturally (file2 before file10), like Dolphin.
explanation: FolderModel::lessThan compared names with a freshly constructed default QCollator, which has numeric mode off and is case-sensitive, so digits were compared as text and file10 came before file2. Dolphin sorts naturally and case-insensitively by default. The model now keeps one QCollator set up in its constructor: numeric and case-insensitive by default, or plain case-sensitive/case-insensitive when dolphinrc [General] SortingChoice says so.

commits.message:
foldermodel: sort names naturally like Dolphin

Folder View compared names with a default QCollator, so file10 sorted
before file2. It now uses numeric, case-insensitive comparison unless
Dolphin is set to case-sensitive or case-insensitive sorting instead.

BUG: 466544

media.caption: Master: file1, file10, file11, file12, file2…
Fixed: file1, file2 … file9, file10, file11, file12

review.text: Using a cached member QCollator configured for numeric, case-insensitive sorting by default while honoring dolphinrc [General] SortingChoice is the right approach and also improves sorting performance. However, enabling case-insensitive and numeric collation exposes a pre-existing strict-weak-ordering bug at the end of FolderModel::lessThan(): line 1746 returns QString::compare(...) directly without '< 0', so any two files that compare equal under the collator (such as 'A.txt' and 'a.txt', or 'file1.txt' and 'file01.txt') return true in both directions, causing undefined behavior and potential crashes in QSortFilterProxyModel's sort.
changes: Fix the fallback return at the end of FolderModel::lessThan() in containments/desktop/plugins/folder/foldermodel.cpp to return `QString::compare(leftItem.url().url(), rightItem.url().url(), Qt::CaseSensitive) < 0;` so strict weak ordering holds for case-insensitive and numeric-mode ties.

Add unit tests in foldermodeltest covering natural numeric sorting (e.g. file1, file2, file10) as well as equal-collation tie-breakers (e.g. A.txt vs a.txt and file1.txt vs file01.txt) to verify strict weak ordering.

reviews.text: Small, correct fix in FolderModel::lessThan: one member QCollator, numeric and case-insensitive by default, following Dolphin's SortingChoice (stored by enum name, with an unset key meaning NaturalSorting, as Dolphin does). This also stops building a QCollator on every comparison. The screenshots and the case-sensitivity checks match the commit message and line. Nits: Dolphin's natural mode compares base name and extension separately (decimal-aware), so a few edge cases can still differ, and a SortingChoice change only applies after plasmashell restarts; a KConfigWatcher on dolphinrc that re-invalidates would make it live.
